records.note: 'Future Nobel prize recipient Nolan Williams' is a prize award to a named person. A Nobel Prize is not a regulatory, trial, company or market, payer or policy, or adoption outcome; consistent with the earlier Nobel items (owen-0174, owen-0425, owen-0834, owen-1022). The phrase is also passing admiration with no date. The forecaster's role on a SAINT post-marketing study does not change the area.

'We can do even better if we place these coils in just the right spot' is a capability claim with a comparative ('even better' than the 78 percent remission of the accelerated H1-coil trial) but no trial, cohort, endpoint threshold, resolution source or date. The cited data are retrospective and the study authors call for prospective validation; no prospective study is named. Nothing observable can be written without inventing the trial and the threshold.

'Plausible ... could be determined' for structural-MRI-based H-coil placement at lower cost: no study, product, regulator, cost threshold or date. A technology-feasibility conjecture; no observable event can be written.

'Depression may be a solved problem for the vast majority of people shortly, if only insurance keeps up' is a slogan. 'Solved problem' and 'vast majority' have no series or threshold; 'shortly' is not a deadline (anchors.json); the insurance condition names no payer, policy or code. Not a conditional item because neither A nor B is a writable event.

Whether the author keeps working on his own novel ('I may or may not keep working on') is his own decision; no third party decides. The statement is also outside the five areas and hedged to no expectation. CONTROL is applied because the own-control test fails first.

'Well-designed studies will suss out the truth' names no trial, sponsor, design, endpoint or date, and 'the truth' about whether therapy adds to psychedelic or ketamine treatment has no threshold. The condition ('if we will allow dispassionate science') is not an observable event. Nothing can be written without inventing the trial.

Expectation that post-treatment psychotherapy after a psychedelic 'should be' no less effective than therapy added to Prozac or Zoloft. A comparative with no named trial, population, endpoint or benchmark value, and no date. 'Should' is predictive here, so NORMATIVE does not apply; VAGUE does.

Compound claim. (a) Ibogaine 'holds remarkable promise, perhaps above all others, to relieve profound human suffering' is a slogan with no trial, regulator, indication or threshold. (b) 'Really, really hard to argue that the therapy could assist much during the process' is an argument about in-session therapy with no trial or measurable comparison. Neither half yields an observable event, so the record is not split. No horizon words.

'All of these studies established that psilocybin may be a useful treatment' summarizes published trials (COMP360, the NYU alcohol use disorder study, veteran PTSD studies). A retrospective evidence summary; no future state, trial readout or decision is asserted.

'We will spend endless time ignoring the causes of problems, and pouring gas on fires' is rhetoric about public-health priorities: no body, decision, series, threshold or date. 'Endless time' is not a deadline. A slogan; nothing observable can be written.

Counterfactual ('In a just world, we would be focusing on the prevention of the abuse of children'); the next sentence says this is not the world we live in. A value statement about a world the author does not expect; no future state is asserted. Not a conditional forecast because no observable A or B can be written.

event.asset: brexpiprazole (Rexulti) in combination with sertraline for post-traumatic stress disorder, the Otsuka/Lundbeck supplemental application under FDA review in July 2025
event.title: Brexpiprazole plus sertraline for PTSD: FDA approval of the supplemental application
event.proposition: The FDA approves brexpiprazole (Rexulti) in combination with sertraline for the treatment of post-traumatic stress disorder.
event.criterion: TRUE on the date of the FDA approval letter or Drugs@FDA supplement entry (the sponsor's approval announcement is the secondary source) that adds a PTSD indication for brexpiprazole used in combination with sertraline. A complete response letter, a positive advisory committee vote or a filing acceptance is not an approval; a complete response letter does not resolve the event FALSE, the event stays open to the end of the window. A label that names PTSD with any sertraline co-administration wording counts.

resolution_source.name: Drugs@FDA; sponsor press release as a secondary source

readings: 'Didn't clear the bar' read as: the FDA does not approve the application. The next sentence ('the advisory committee vote isn't binding, but ...') shows the sentence is about the FDA decision, not only the committee vote.
Rexulti, brexpiprazole and 'brexpiprazole/sertraline' name the same asset; the indication is PTSD as filed in the supplemental application.

records.stage_note: Supplemental application (brexpiprazole with sertraline for PTSD) under FDA review on the statement date. Per the post, the FDA advisory committee (CDER) voted 10-1 against it in the week of the statement; only one of two Phase III trials separated from placebo. No FDA action yet; the forecaster gives no PDUFA date. Class: approval after a negative advisory committee vote (p 0.33, median 12 months).
records.note: Denial of FDA approval of brexpiprazole plus sertraline for PTSD: 'This is one that (probably) didn't clear the bar', followed by 'the advisory committee vote isn't binding, but the overwhelming majority were clear in their decision'. Read as the forecaster's own expectation that the FDA follows the committee and declines the application. The strongest phrase '(probably)' sets bin B; asserts false, so p(E) = 0.3. No date or PDUFA words, so the item is undated (24-month window from 2025-07-21). Not KNOWN: the committee vote is advisory and the FDA decision was pending. Otsuka and Lundbeck are not in the forecaster's affiliations; not affiliated.

'Thirteen million people in the US will have PTSD in any given year' and '600/100,000 will have PTSD in their lifetime' restate prevalence statistics in the future tense. Descriptive; no change, decision or event is asserted. Also outside the five areas.

'It's even more likely now' has an ambiguous referent (more involuntary treatment happening, or the relevance of the author's critique) and names no body, rule, series, threshold or date. The executive order on civil commitment is mentioned as already proposed, not as the event. No observable event can be written from the sentence.

'And soon psychedelic treatments', in a list of available rapid-acting treatments, implies future availability or approval of psychedelic drugs but names no drug, sponsor, indication or regulator: 'psychedelic treatments' is a class with no countable set. 'Soon' is not a deadline (anchors.json). Later in the post the author hedges 'if approved by the FDA'. No asset can be written without inventing it.

'If they treated patients more quickly, they would make less money per patient, since they are paid per day, in 75% of settings' describes the current per-diem payment mechanism in the conditional mood. A structural explanation of present incentives; no future state, decision or event is asserted.

Conditional extrapolation from Emanuel et al. (NY Fed Staff Report 1158): suicide and overdose deaths would rise 0.98 percentage points per 10-point rise in edge-case hospitalization propensity if the civil-commitment executive order is implemented. A population mortality outcome is not a regulatory, trial, company or market, payer or policy, or adoption outcome. No data series or reporting date is named either.

Sibling of owen-1815: charges for violent crime within 3 months would rise 2.6 percentage points per 10-point rise in admission likelihood under the administration's plan. A crime outcome is outside the five areas; also a model extrapolation with no named series or date.

Compound conclusion of the extrapolation: more involuntarily admitted patients 'will' die and 'violence against others is likely to ensue' if the civil-commitment push is enacted. Deaths and violence are outside the five areas; no series, threshold or date. Not split because neither half is admissible.

Policy verdict ('a terrible idea', normative) plus the extrapolated death risk (3.3 percent for the three months after discharge at a 100 percent hospitalization rate). The measurable half is a population mortality outcome, outside the five areas, and no data series is named that would report it. The normative half is not a forecast.

'This practice shift will be challenging' has no measure: no adoption series, threshold, population of clinicians or date. 'Challenging' is not an observable outcome. Practice adoption area, but nothing can be written.

General clinical causal claim (family accommodation worsens a child's anxiety 'over time' and increases demands for accommodation), restating Shepherd et al. 2025 and a 2016 meta-analysis. A mechanism statement about any child, not a forecast of a dated event; also outside the five areas. 'Over time' is not a deadline.

Implicit expectation that the Moleon-Ruiz et al. rTMS-for-suicidal-ideation findings will 'hold up' a year later. 'Hold up' has no replication study, endpoint or threshold; 'a year later' dates the author's possible embarrassment, not a named readout. No trial or resolution source can be written without inventing it.
'I think this scientific paper will make a fine article' is a judgment about the author's own newsletter post; no third party decides and no outcome in the five areas.

Implies that murder-suicide rates (Keyes et al., NVDRS, 0.5 per 100,000 in 2022) will not hold stable in 2025. A population mortality rate is outside the five areas. The sentence also gives no direction or threshold in the forecaster's words ('not a phenomenon to count on', 'it seems'), so it would be VAGUE as a quantity claim even inside an area.

Conditional and hedged: if society 'bulks up' adept therapists, they 'might' treat would-be perpetrators before violence. Neither A (investment in therapists) nor B (prevented violence) has a countable set, series, threshold or date.
'More data are on the way' for accelerated TMS names no trial, sponsor, endpoint or publication; 'on the way' is not a deadline. A trial_result event cannot be written without inventing the trial.

Bet that pets get access to accelerated TMS before UnitedHealth Group plans cover it for humans. The payer half (UnitedHealthcare covers accelerated TMS) could be a coverage_decision event, but the claim is a relative ordering against a comparator with no threshold: 'pets getting access' (restated as 'at scale' in owen-1833) has no countable set, series or number, so the ordering cannot resolve. 'Before' gives no deadline. Coding the payer half alone as a denial inside the 24-month window would invent a claim the forecaster did not make. 'I'll put a cash-money bet' would set bin A if the claim were admitted.
